insight.title: Why You Reject Better Ideas Because They Are Inconvenient
insight.subtitle: How your daily routine can block real progress

sections.text: Your most innovative ideas are often killed by your current calendar, not your competitors. We frequently mistake "this will be difficult to organize" for "this is a poor strategic choice."

We naturally favor decisions that slide neatly into existing workflows. However, true innovation is rarely a perfect fit; it usually requires reshaping how you spend your energy rather than just adding to it.

When you prioritize ease of implementation over the value of the outcome, you settle for minor improvements. Breakthroughs feel disruptive because they demand a departure from the comfort of your current routine.
Try this today: The next time you dismiss an idea because it feels inconvenient today, ask if it’s actually better.
A strategy that fits perfectly into your current routine is likely just more of the same.
